decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core two-component spraying know-how, and its own R&D and university cooperation let it learn from early results and refine the system.
The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established injection equipment portfolio, is presented on its own page, and is easy for the firm to interpret and improve.
The material transfer pump builds directly on the firm's long-standing conveying and pump engineering, so it fits existing absorptive capacity well.

Fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat further from core application equipment but builds on established flow and pump know-how, has its own page, and supports the firm's digitalization goals, so the firm can still assimilate feedback from it.
